channel.title: Puzzle Break
channel.description: Short puzzles for a two-minute break, with full solutions.

item.title: How to Solve a 6x6 Sudoku, With an Original Practice Grid
item.description: Learn the two techniques that crack most 6x6 sudoku grids, then try an original 12-clue puzzle with exactly one solution and a full answer grid.

item.title: A Logic Grid and Whodunit Warm-up
item.description: Three original step-by-step deduction puzzles, a bake-off order, a dessert logic grid, and a whodunit, with verified answers at the end.

item.title: Three Code-Breaking Puzzles to Warm Up Your Brain
item.description: An original letter-shift cipher, an alphabet riddle, and a missing-link word puzzle, each with the answer checked against every possible case.

item.title: Three Number Sequences to Test Your Pattern Spotting
item.description: Three original number sequence puzzles covering multiplication, triangular-style numbers, and growing gaps, with every answer checked.

item.title: Three Trick Questions That Test Your Assumptions
item.description: Three original lateral-thinking puzzles, an algebra riddle, a price-split riddle, and a time riddle, each answer checked against every stated condition.
